summary_1line: Sauti finishes the tale of Astika and begins introducing Vyasa and the forthcoming recitation of the Mahabharata at Janamejaya’s sacrifice.

image_candidates.scene_text: The sage Vyasa enters King Janamejaya’s vast sacrificial pavilion while priests, kings, and sages rise to honor him.
King Janamejaya bows and offers water, arghya, and a golden seat to his great‑grandfather Vyasa amid the ritual fire of the sacrifice.
